scope: same union RTL modes14 MAC,15 original fixed DA,13 paid conservative hybrid/eager,12 conservative hybrid/lazy,11 remaining-work hybrid/lazy; K864/N96/T10/R8

arithmetic.coefficient_note: All modes retain eight signed19x13 multiplier expressions; Q2 is signed16 extended to19. Same declared compute lanes is not an area/Fmax equivalence claim.

z.access: 208-bit vector reads/write during producer/final support scan and DA_POS; selected-bank26-bit read in BASE_MAC; mutually exclusive states. No additional z copy beyond existing DA_z_hold.

psum.access: one256bit STORE or DRAIN_READ; all480rows overwritten beforedrain

v_live.generation: OR ofcfg Q2 vector, computed inRTL

DA_LUT.access: one144bit vectorread and one144bit write perbuild; one144bit read perDA_MAC
DA_LUT.lifecycle: Exactly one current N8 table; invalidate after each Q2 block fill and at command start. Mode15 builds all12 blocks,13 builds nonempty blocks,12/11 build at first position with more than2 active ranks. Always overwritten next N8, no cross-tile/table cache.

DA_LUT_live.access: up to26 indexed metadata checks at ENCODE; fullfinite32bit table

other_state: integer loop/address counters, state/mode, remaining8bit, 2 active-half flags, origins and counters; metadata arrays explicitly listed, not inferred free
common_permissions: same26bit bank words and208bit vector port
same carry-cut permission and19x13 multiplier declarations
Every added array/unit/port is physically declared once and available to both modes; not separately synthesized area equivalence.
critical_path_scope: BASE_MAC permits async z bank mux/half selection plus heldQ2vector selection, signed multiply and32bit add in one cycle. No Fmax/physicalSRAM mapping.; DA_MAC asynchronous144bit LUTselect,8 variable leftshifts and32bit sign/add; ENCODE13bit width detection and26 finite mask/meta selections; no PPA/Fmax.
runtime_external_note: source_allow andweight_allow gate on-chip array reads; not aDDR/NoC response model
no_claim: no full-frame/full-I24 consumer measurement in this leaf
no new training or AEE evaluation
no novelty proof from a control repair
configuration_integrity: k_live is static supplied metadata equal to OR_r(Q1[r,k]!=0), checked independently for every fixture. SV computes Q2 v_live at cfg. Supported runs load all required configuration in IDLE; no run-time cfg or arbitrary invalid metadata contract.
runtime_construction: 32 physical states per built N8 =2zero table writes+30sharedALU adds. Every construction is paid; modes12/11 lazy first evaluation resumes at DA_POS. No predicted or free amortization.

new_control.combinational: two8-input support popcounts, one26-input encoded popcount, cost comparator and next-block support mux; existing width detection/26 live lookups retained
new_control.observation_counters: six32-bit counters (192 additional FF bits) count evaluations, decisions, bypasses, savedMAC and builtblocks; not data-buffer capacity

selector: Only >2rank positions evaluate. All evaluated positions pay DA_POS+DA_ENCODE. Modes13/12 require2+DA<rank; corrected11 compares DA<rank after common detection/build fees are sunk. Fallback pays all sunk fees; no zero-cost oracle.
